Priya R: Heads-up — taking over handoff for Solaris Health launch. They have a VIP midnight rollout on Tue 03/30, expected burst to ~3x normal qps for ~20min. No current incidents but wanted to flag risk and coverage plan.
Liam B: Thanks — is this the same tenant that hit the KV cache thrash last month?
Priya R: Yes, same. We applied prefix caching but not full TTL tuning. If they hit longer sequences we might see elevated p95 CPU.
Eve M: I can cover the 11pm-2am window PST. @Jamal S can you take the 2am-5am?
Jamal S: I can do 2-5am. Will set myself as primary in PagerDuty for that window.
Nora K: Re routing — recommend enabling fallback to smaller model variant (gpt-small-optim) on load spikes. Config snippet I suggest: 
```yaml
routes:
  - match: "solar:*"
    primary: gpt-large-v2
    fallback: gpt-small-optim
    fallback_threshold_rps: 1200
```
Priya R: Good call. Also suggest turning on prefix caching with max_ttl=45s for their user-agent header.
Liam B: Any change to SLA or legal contact? We may need to prioritize reconnects if they breach contracts.
Priya R: Contract SLA is 99.9% with 5min warmup grace. Legal already looped — contact is @nora.k (Nora K).
Eve M: I'll run a quick load check in staging tonight at 9pm PST and post results. If we see >2.5x, push the fallback threshold lower.
Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: Solaris preload test at 2026-03-30T07:00:00Z (automation).
Jamal S: Where are the escalation playbooks? Last time I had to swap keys and it was messy.
Priya R: Playbook links below (internal): https://redwood.internal/playbooks/solarismigration — steps 2-6 are most relevant. TL;DR: rotate keys -> clear KV cache for prefix -> enable fallback -> observe 30s.
Nora K: FYI I tested the fallback mapping last week, warm handoff worked fine but observed 10% quality regression on long prompts. Make sure product knows fallback might reduce output fidelity.
Liam B: Noted. I'll ping Product to set expectation and hold a quick canary with QA.
Eve M: After staging run I'll upload traces and a short perf dashboard snapshot here.
Priya R: Thanks all. Action items: Eve run staging @9pm PST; Jamal oncall 2-5am; Nora legal/contact & fallback mapping; Liam handle product ping + canary. I'll be on until 11pm then handoff to Eve. :thumbsup:
Jamal S: Acknowledged.
Eve M: ACK — will post results.
Oncall Bot: PagerDuty shift updated: Jamal S 02:00-05:00 PST (autogenerated).
